title: Glob lab
description: Write and fix glob patterns against a list of paths: see the matched files in a tree, which expectations pass, and the regex each glob becomes.
needs: one or more glob parts ({pattern, dot?, nocase?}) and a paths part (a string with one path per line)
query: [.messages[] ~ {kind: "glob"}] as $globs | [.messages[] ~ {kind: "paths", data: $text} | select(($text | type) == "string")] as $paths | ($globs | length) > 0 and ($paths | length) > 0
